title: Carjacker Shoots Woman in Shocking Robbery Outside Panera Bread
description:
A New Mexico woman is behind bars after shooting someone in a mall parking lot in Albuquerque, New Mexico in July 2023. Court records show Laura Tapia, 32, was sentenced to over three years in prison after pleading guilty to aggravated battery with a deadly weapon and attempted armed battery. Police said Laura approached two sisters in the parking lot outside Panera Bread and demanded their car before one of the sisters stood up to the 32-year-old. That’s when Laura fired at the woman and ran away. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
